 │ pages through (`upload_pages` + web-lib.sh), exports
 │ "versioned" (static redirections: per-folder
 │ # configurations + routes, cached by day) + signatures
 │ `site-manifest`. Files copied > release/,'''
 │ new='''# Uploads, the whole (web). Builds publish the new
 │ pages through (`upload_pages` + web-lib.sh), exports
 │ # "versioned" (static redirections: per-folder
 │ configurations + routes, cached by day) + signatures
 │ # `site-manifest`. Files copied > release/,'''
 │ assert s.count(old)==1
 │ open(p,'w',encoding='utf-8').write(s.replace(old,new))

 │ sed -n 1,8p scripts/deploy-docs.sh; bash -n
